This is a leave-on body serum, an oil-based skin-care preparation, so it falls in heading 3304 (beauty or make-up preparations and skin-care preparations). The remaining question is the subheading, and I'm working from memory of the schedule rather than a checked ruling.

Within 3304.99, the "other" lines include 3304.99.50 (other, including skin-care preparations). The statistical suffix for "other" under 3304.99.50 is 3304.99.5000. Since the product is not a medicament and not specifically a cream, lotion, or other listed item, the general skin-care line applies.

The 3304.99 subheading covers "Other," and it splits into 3304.99.10 (lotions for babies), 3304.99.20 (anti-acne), 3304.99.30 (other, of Lotions...), 3304.99.50 (other), and 3304.99.60 (other). I believe 3304.99.50 reads "Other: Other" and is correct, with the 10-digit code 3304.99.5000.

I recall that CBP rulings on similar oil-based body serums (including ones made in Thailand) classify them under 3304.99.5000.
